Hi Elena — thanks, got the form and W-9. Looping in Laura (procurement ops) and Vivek (finance) to get vendor record started. Below is the standard checklist we use — if you can return items in the next 5–7 business days we can generate a PO and kick off the pilot next week.

What we need from you (from vendor):
- Completed Vendor Setup Form (we received your attachment; procurement ops may follow up on missing fields)
- W-9 (received) or W-8 for non-US entities
- Company legal name + registered address + EIN/TIN (confirm on form)
- Remittance / ACH instructions or bank details (bank name, account, routing; secure portal preferred)
- Certificate of Insurance (GL and E&O where applicable)
- Primary contract/legal point of contact (name + email)
- Invoice example (PDF) and preferred invoice delivery method (email/portal/EDI)
- Any special tax paperwork (1099 considerations)

What Redwood will provide / next steps from our side:
- Procurement ops will validate form fields and create vendor record in our ERP
- Finance will confirm invoice routing and preferred remit email / AP contact
- We will issue an initial PO for the pilot scope once vendor is active (POs are created after vendor record + tax validation)
- Standard payment terms: Net30 unless otherwise agreed; request to include early-pay options in notes if desired
- We can accept a standalone PO for the pilot; contracts team will advise if MSSA signature is required for production beyond pilot

Attachments: Redwood_Supplier_Onboarding_Checklist_v1.pdf, Redwood_PO_Template.docx

Can you confirm: preferred invoice address and whether you can provide ACH details via secure form? Laura, Vivek — can you confirm expected vendor-creation SLA so I can set Glacial's expectations?

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Senior Manager, Procurement
Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai

From: Elena Ruiz <elena@glacialai.com>

Subject: Re: Vendor account initiation: Glacial AI / Redwood Inference

Thanks Monica — quick clarifications below and attached our completed form so you have the latest.

- Invoice routing: AP@glacialai.com is our preferred email; we also support invoice uploads to our portal (we can provide credentials if Redwood has a vendor portal).
- ACH: we prefer to send ACH via your secure vendor portal; if that is not possible we can provide bank details in an encrypted PDF.
- Contract: pilot can proceed on PO only; if Redwood needs a signed MSSA for later stages we can execute in parallel.
- Expected go-live: Is it possible to have the vendor record created and a PO issued by 2028-03-20? We're hoping to start usage that week.

Attached: Supplier_Form_GlacialAI_filled.xlsx (completed), GlacialAI_W9.pdf (copy)

On a separate note — do you have a preferred PO reference format we should include on our invoices?

Best,
Elena
